title: Depth Anything V2
description: Depth Anything V2: relative depth from one image, in small, base and large. The licence differs by size, see the table.
html:

Details
  • Paper: Depth Anything V2, NeurIPS 2024, 2024-06-13 (for depth-anything-v2-s, depth-anything-v2-b, depth-anything-v2-l, depth-anything-v2-metric-hypersim-s, depth-anything-v2-metric-hypersim-b, depth-anything-v2-metric-hypersim-l, depth-anything-v2-metric-vkitti-s, depth-anything-v2-metric-vkitti-b, depth-anything-v2-metric-vkitti-l)
  • Paper: Distill Any Depth: Distillation Creates a Stronger Monocular Depth Estimator, arXiv, 2025-02-26 (for distill-any-depth-s, distill-any-depth-b, distill-any-depth-l)
  • Original code: https://github.com/DepthAnything/Depth-Anything-V2 at a561b84
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
    • depth-anything-v2-b: CC-BY-NC-4.0
    • depth-anything-v2-l: CC-BY-NC-4.0
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/DepthAnything/Depth-Anything-V2/blob/main/README.md (LICENSE section) and the Hugging Face model cards
  • Training data: Teacher (ViT-G) on 595K synthetic images (BlendedMVS, Hypersim, IRS, TartanAir, VKITTI 2); students on 62M pseudo-labelled real images (SA-1B, Open Images, BDD100K, Google Landmarks, ImageNet-21K, LSUN, Objects365, Places365) per the paper
    • depth-anything-v2-metric-hypersim-s: Fine-tuned from the relative Depth Anything V2 Small on Hypersim (indoor, synthetic) per the metric_depth README
    • depth-anything-v2-metric-hypersim-b: Fine-tuned from the relative Depth Anything V2 Base on Hypersim (indoor, synthetic) per the metric_depth README
    • depth-anything-v2-metric-hypersim-l: Fine-tuned from the relative Depth Anything V2 Large on Hypersim (indoor, synthetic) per the metric_depth README
    • depth-anything-v2-metric-vkitti-s: Fine-tuned from the relative Depth Anything V2 Small on Virtual KITTI 2 (outdoor driving, synthetic) per the metric_depth README
    • depth-anything-v2-metric-vkitti-b: Fine-tuned from the relative Depth Anything V2 Base on Virtual KITTI 2 (outdoor driving, synthetic) per the metric_depth README
    • depth-anything-v2-metric-vkitti-l: Fine-tuned from the relative Depth Anything V2 Large on Virtual KITTI 2 (outdoor driving, synthetic) per the metric_depth README
    • distill-any-depth-s: Distilled from Depth Anything V2 and GenPercept teachers on 200K unlabeled SA-1B images per the paper (arXiv 2502.19204)
    • distill-any-depth-b: Distilled from Depth Anything V2 and GenPercept teachers on 200K unlabeled SA-1B images per the paper (arXiv 2502.19204)
    • distill-any-depth-l: Distilled from Depth Anything V2 and GenPercept teachers on 200K unlabeled SA-1B images per the paper (arXiv 2502.19204)
  • Licence note: Only the Small weights are Apache-2.0; the Base and Large weights are CC-BY-NC-4.0. The training data of even the Small model has unclear commercial terms (a note only).
  • Licence note: The six metric checkpoints are Apache-2.0 on their Hugging Face cards, but the Base / Large ones are fine-tuned from the CC-BY-NC-4.0 relative Base / Large weights, and Virtual KITTI 2 (the outdoor fine-tune) is CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, Hypersim CC BY-SA 3.0.
  • Licence note: Distill-Any-Depth: Apache-2.0 on the Hugging Face card (the authors' transformers ports say MIT, the code is MIT). The paper initialises the Large model from the CC-BY-NC-4.0 Depth Anything V2 Large weights; its teachers include Depth Anything V2 and it trains on unlabeled SA-1B images (research licence).
  • Options: short_side = 518 (>= 14; also input_size)
  • Kernel libraries: fastbb, dpt_fused
  • Variants: depth-anything-v2-s, depth-anything-v2-b, depth-anything-v2-l, depth-anything-v2-metric-hypersim-s, depth-anything-v2-metric-hypersim-b, depth-anything-v2-metric-hypersim-l, depth-anything-v2-metric-vkitti-s, depth-anything-v2-metric-vkitti-b, depth-anything-v2-metric-vkitti-l, distill-any-depth-s, distill-any-depth-b, distill-any-depth-l
  • Outputs: inverse_depth, depth; kind: affine_invariant_inverse
  • Input size:
    • depth-anything-v2-s, depth-anything-v2-b, depth-anything-v2-l: any H x W >= 8, resized or padded inside the model (ViT patch 14)
    • depth-anything-v2-metric-hypersim-s, depth-anything-v2-metric-hypersim-b, depth-anything-v2-metric-hypersim-l, depth-anything-v2-metric-vkitti-s, depth-anything-v2-metric-vkitti-b, depth-anything-v2-metric-vkitti-l, distill-any-depth-s, distill-any-depth-b, distill-any-depth-l: any H x W >= 1, resized or padded inside the model (ViT patch 14)
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): depth-anything-v2-s 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved); depth-anything-v2-b 3000x4000 (0.8 GiB peak allocated, 0.9 reserved); depth-anything-v2-l 3000x4000 (1.8 GiB peak allocated, 2.2 reserved); depth-anything-v2-metric-hypersim-s not measured yet; depth-anything-v2-metric-hypersim-b not measured yet; depth-anything-v2-metric-hypersim-l not measured yet; depth-anything-v2-metric-vkitti-s not measured yet; depth-anything-v2-metric-vkitti-b not measured yet; depth-anything-v2-metric-vkitti-l not measured yet; distill-any-depth-s not measured yet; distill-any-depth-b not measured yet; distill-any-depth-l not measured yet

Limitations

  • Metric checkpoints predict at most max_depth (20 m Hypersim, 80 m Virtual KITTI 2): the head is a sigmoid scaled by it. Each was fine-tuned on one synthetic domain, so indoor / outdoor scenes outside it get a wrong scale.
  • Distill-Any-Depth runs with this family's pipeline (short side 518, aspect kept, as the authors' transformers ports); the authors' demo squashes to 700 x 700. Their Dav2-Teacher-Large-2w-iter checkpoint is not included.
